name: Piveteausaurus
isnote: PBDB places it in Eustreptospondylinae; the Wikipedia lead describes only a theropod of uncertain affinities, so its position below Megalosauridae is not settled.
sum: Middle Jurassic theropod from the Marnes de Dives of Calvados, France, known from a partial skull.
